name: @frontierfun/mcp-server

tools.name: get_token_state
tools.description: Get the on-chain state of a Frontier coin. Returns its launch mode (curve or instant), current price and supply, the bonding-curve TVL and parameters (virtual reserves, initial supply, max supply, target ETH), whether it trades on its Uniswap V4 pool yet (isLPd, lpd_at), the pool id and a live pool block once it does, the creator and current fee recipient, the curve fee in basis points, the community fee ratio routed to the staking vault, and the graduation payout estimate. Use this to evaluate a coin before trading.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: quote_buy
tools.description: Simulate a bonding-curve buy WITHOUT executing. Curve buys raise the price with each purchase; the quote returns the coins received for a given ETH input with the curve fee taken from that ETH (fee-inclusive), whether the buy would graduate the coin, and the ETH left to graduation. Curve coins only (an instant or graduated coin trades on its Uniswap V4 pool: use quote_pool_swap). Use before buy_token.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: quote_sell
tools.description: Simulate a bonding-curve sell WITHOUT executing. Selling returns ETH from the curve reserve and lowers the price; the curve fee is taken from the ETH output. Curve coins only, before graduation (a graduated or instant coin sells on its Uniswap V4 pool: use quote_pool_swap).

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Check the agent wallet balance on Robinhood Chain for ETH, WETH (wrapped ETH, the asset referral rewards and staking WETH rewards are paid in), or any coin / ERC-20 by contract address.

asset.description: What to check: 'eth', 'weth', or a coin contract address

tools.name: check_graduation
tools.description: Estimate how close a curve coin is to graduating, i.e. moving from the bonding curve into its locked Uniswap V4 pool. Returns the supply left to buy, the ETH needed to fill the curve, and the graduation payouts (fee recipient, protocol and graduation-caller shares as configured today, read live). Graduation happens when total supply reaches the max supply. Instant coins never graduate.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_pool_state
tools.description: Read the live Uniswap V4 pool of a coin: pool id and key (ETH is currency0, the coin is currency1, Frontier hook), whether the pool is initialized (a curve coin has a dormant pool until it graduates), sqrtPriceX96 / tick / in-range liquidity, the price in ETH per coin and its FDV, the fee a swap pays right now (total / LP / non-LP in pips and bps, from the hook's previewFee), the hook configuration (base fee, LP share, sniper window, bound fee calculators and observers, staking vault, community fee ratio) and the protocol's share of the non-LP side. Both launch modes register and initialize the pool in the deploy transaction, so `initialized` is true from birth and proves nothing about where the coin trades: a curve coin's pool is dormant (zero liquidity, swaps revert `NotLPd`) until `isLPd` turns true. Use is_graduated / trading_venue for that.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_pool_key
tools.description: Compute the Uniswap V4 pool key and pool id of a coin locally (no RPC): every Frontier pool is {currency0: native ETH, currency1: coin, dynamic-fee flag, tick spacing 60, hooks: Frontier hook}. Use when another tool or contract call needs the pool id or key. A pool id existing does not mean the coin trades there yet: check isLPd (get_token_state).

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: preview_pool_fee
tools.description: Preview the swap fee the coin's Uniswap V4 pool would charge right now for a given trade, straight from the Frontier hook (previewFee): total fee, the LP share and the non-LP share (creator / community / protocol), in pips (1e6 = 100%) and basis points. Pool fees are dynamic (base fee, dynamic-fee curve, sniper tax, maturity curve ...), so quote rather than assume. side='buy' is ETH in, side='sell' is coin in.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

side.description: 'buy' = ETH in / coin out; 'sell' = coin in / ETH out

amount_in.description: Amount you would spend, decimal string (ETH for buy, coins for sell)

tools.name: quote_pool_swap
tools.description: Off-chain quote for a swap on a coin's Uniswap V4 pool WITHOUT executing (graduated or instant coins). side='buy' is ETH -> coin; side='sell' is coin -> ETH (native ETH, no wrapping). Provide EXACTLY ONE of amount_in (exact-input: spend X) or amount_out (exact-output: receive exactly X). The quote runs the hook, so the returned amount already includes the pool's dynamic fee. Returns the counter-amount, the fee in pips, a gas estimate and the resulting price. Throws for a curve coin that has not graduated.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

side.description: 'buy' = ETH in / coin out; 'sell' = coin in / ETH out

amount_in.description: Exact-input: amount you spend, decimal string (ETH for buy, coins for sell). Mutually exclusive with amount_out.

amount_out.description: Exact-output: amount you receive, decimal string (coins for buy, ETH for sell). Mutually exclusive with amount_in.

hook_data.description: Optional hex hookData passed to the pool hook (advanced; e.g. abi.encode(beneficiary) for observer attribution). Default: none.

tools.name: check_otc_transfer
tools.description: Check whether a direct wallet-to-wallet transfer of a coin is allowed between two addresses. Curve coins cannot be transferred before graduation (only the factory and the vesting contract are exempt); once a coin trades on its Uniswap V4 pool (graduated, or an instant launch from birth) it transfers freely as a standard ERC-20.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_highlight_status
tools.description: Check whether a coin can be highlighted (promoted on Frontier) for a duration and get the quoted fee in ETH. Pricing is linear up to a threshold, then each extra second costs more; one highlight slot exists globally and each coin has a cooldown after its highlight ends. Read the live values with get_highlight_config.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

duration_seconds.description: How long to highlight in seconds

tools.name: get_referral_reward
tools.description: Check pending referral rewards (in WETH) earned from curve trades of the traders you referred: a share of the curve fee they pay goes to their referrer. Use claim_referral_reward to withdraw.

reward_token.description: Reward token address to check (WETH on Robinhood Chain)

tools.name: get_cooldown_status
tools.description: Check staking-vault cooldown progress. After requesting an unstake, the coins sit in a cooldown (the vault reports its duration). This shows the amount in cooldown, when it ends, and whether it is ready to claim via complete_unstake.

tools.name: get_vesting_info
tools.description: Check the agent wallet vesting schedule for a coin. Shows cliff, vesting duration, total vested amount, and how much is releasable now via release_vested_tokens.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: View the agent current configuration: trading defaults (slippage, gas reserve, affiliate), risk parameters (stop-loss, take-profit, max exposure), strategy settings, and operational flags (dry-run, logging).

tools.name: is_protocol_paused
tools.description: Check whether Frontier is paused by the admin. When paused, new coin launches and bonding-curve trades are blocked; Uniswap V4 pool trading is never paused.

tools.name: get_staking_vault_address
tools.description: Look up the staking vault of a coin from the Frontier hook's pool state. A vault exists only when the creator chose one at launch; it receives the community share of the creator's pool fees (community_fee_ratio) plus the community share of locked-liquidity collections. Returns null when the coin has no vault.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_staking_position
tools.description: Get a staking position in a vault: shares held, underlying coin amount, maximum withdrawable / redeemable amounts, cooldown duration for unstaking, and the WETH rewards earned so far.

tools.name: get_staking_rewards
tools.description: Read the WETH reward stream of a staking vault for the agent wallet: earned_weth (claimable now via claim_staking_rewards) and pending_weth (rewards buffered while the vault had no stakers). Coin rewards accrue in the share price and need no claim.

tools.name: get_referral_fees
tools.description: Get the referral share of the curve trade fee, as configured today: direct referral BPS (earned from the traders you referred), indirect referral BPS (from the traders they referred), and the total.

tools.name: get_highlight_config
tools.description: Get the highlight (promotion) configuration as set today: minimum duration, hard cap, base fee per second, and the cooldown between highlights of the same coin.

tools.name: get_all_vesting_schedules
tools.description: Get all vesting schedules of the agent wallet for a coin. Includes each schedule ID, cliff, duration, amount, and releasable balance.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_creation_fee
tools.description: Get the ETH fee the factory charges to launch a coin, as configured today (read live; it can be zero). A dev buy rides on top of it as msg.value.

tools.name: get_factory_params
tools.description: Read Frontier's live launch parameters from the factory: the default curve (virtual reserves, initial supply, max supply), the curve bounds (minimum raise, supply ratio window, starting FDV window), the instant-launch FDV window, the fee config (protocol / creator / caller shares of a graduation and the creation fee), the dev-buy cap, the creator share of curve fees and the curve trade fee. These are governance values: read them, never assume them.

tools.name: list_extensions
tools.description: List the hook extensions a coin can bind at launch, from the Frontier catalog: fee calculators (dynamic fee, maturity curve, sniper tax ...), observers and fee recipients, with their status (active / paused / coming-soon), address on this chain, ordering, incompatibilities and parameter schema. Only active entries can be used in deploy_token extensions.

tools.name: get_coin_extensions
tools.description: Read a coin's live pool configuration as the Frontier API serves it: pool id, hook config (base fee in pips, LP share in bps, sniper window, community fee ratio, staking vault), the protocol's share of the non-LP fee side, and the fee calculators / observers bound to the pool joined with the catalog. Falls back to the on-chain hook state when the API has not indexed the pool yet.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_fee_recipient
tools.description: Read the current fee recipient of a coin: the address that receives the creator's share of curve fees, graduation payout and pool fees (the creator wallet unless an alternative recipient was set at launch or afterwards).

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_fee_recipient_state
tools.description: Read the live state of a fee-recipient contract created from Frontier's clone factory. Lottery: the open ticketing round, each round's tickets / prize / draw status, the accruing prize pool and the unclaimed creator share. Buyback-and-burn: the creator share and the WETH waiting to be spent on a buyback. Fee splitter: the payees and their shares, and the balances waiting to be distributed. Any other address is reported as kind null — a plain wallet or a contract Frontier did not mint.

rounds.description: Lottery only: round ids to read (default: the open round and the one before it)

buyer.description: Lottery only: also report this address's ticket count in each round

tools.name: get_pool_fee_schedule
tools.description: Read how a coin's swap fee is shaped over time, extension by extension: the dynamic-fee step curve (floor / mid / cap fees and their volatility thresholds), the sniper tax (peak fee and the window it decays over), the maturity curve (fee per coin age), plus the hook's current volatility and tick observation. Answers 'why is the fee what it is, and where is it heading'; preview_pool_fee answers 'what would this swap pay right now'.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_token_list
tools.description: Fetch and filter the coin list from the cached TokenRegistry. Supports sorting by market_cap, deployment_time, volume, graduation_time, or recent_activity. Supports filtering by status (active = still on its curve / graduated = on its pool), launch mode (curve / instant), market cap range, price range, and creator address. Paginated with offset/limit (default 20 per page). Ask "what coins are hot?" (sort by market_cap), "what launched recently?" (sort by deployment_time), "what is being traded?" (sort by recent_activity).

limit.description: Max coins to return, 0 for all (default: 20, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by graduation status: active = still on the bonding curve, graduated = trading on its pool (default: all)

tools.name: resolve_token
tools.description: Resolve a coin by address, symbol, or name. Returns the matched coin with metadata. If several coins match a symbol/name query, returns the auto-selected coin (highest market cap by default) along with the other matches for disambiguation. Falls back to a server-side search when the coin is not in the local cache. Use this to look up coins before interacting with them.

query.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name (e.g. "My Coin")

tools.name: get_recent_deployments
tools.description: Get the most recently launched coins from the rolling event buffer. Returns a chronological feed of CoinDeployed events with coin metadata (creator, address, name, symbol, launch mode, initial price / market cap, target ETH, timestamp). Updated in real time from on-chain events between API polling cycles.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent deployments to return (default: all in buffer, max 100)

tools.name: get_token_distribution
tools.description: Fetch the holder distribution of a coin from the Frontier API (top holders with amount and percentage). This is an app-only surface served for the app; the shape may change and it reflects bonding-curve balances only: for a coin on its pool read balances on-chain (get_balance). Useful for a first look at concentration.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: get_user_holdings
tools.description: Fetch the coins a wallet has traded from the Frontier API (defaults to the agent wallet). App-only surface served for the app; the shape may change and it carries NO balances: use get_balance for the amount held. Shows each coin with price, market cap, launch mode and graduation status.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to query (optional, defaults to agent wallet)

tools.name: get_user_creations
tools.description: Fetch the coins a wallet created from the Frontier API (defaults to the agent wallet). App-only surface served for the app; the shape may change. Shows each coin with price, market cap, launch mode and graduation status.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to query (optional, defaults to agent wallet)

tools.name: get_current_highlight
tools.description: Fetch the coin highlighted (promoted) right now from the Frontier API. Returns the highlight data or null when no coin is highlighted.

tools.name: buy_token
tools.description: Buy a Frontier coin with ETH. On the bonding curve (a curve coin before graduation) the price rises with each buy and the curve fee is taken from the ETH sent. Once the coin trades on its Uniswap V4 pool (graduated, or an instant launch) the tool AUTO-ROUTES to the pool: same input shape, ETH in / coin out, with the pool's dynamic fee applied instead. The receipt's `path` field says which leg executed ('bonding-curve' or 'v4-pool'). `affiliate` (referrer) only applies on the curve and is dropped on the pool path.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (default: from config, typically 200 = 2%)

affiliate.description: Referrer address for the curve trade (default: from config)

tools.name: sell_token
tools.description: Sell a Frontier coin for ETH. On the bonding curve (before graduation) the sell lowers the price and the curve fee is taken from the ETH out; no approval is needed. Once the coin trades on its Uniswap V4 pool the tool AUTO-ROUTES to the pool (coin in / ETH out) and sets up the Permit2 approval on demand. The receipt's `path` field says which leg executed.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (default: from config, typically 200 = 2%)

affiliate.description: Referrer address for the curve trade (default: from config)

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Pin a coin image to IPFS through the Frontier API (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG, 2 MB max). Returns the ipfs:// URL to pass as the image parameter of deploy_token. Upload first so the image is pinned before the coin exists.

file_path.description: Local file path to the image

tools.name: deploy_token
tools.description: Launch a new coin on Frontier (Robinhood Chain). Two launch modes: 'curve' (default) sells the coin along a bonding curve and graduates it into a locked Uniswap V4 pool once the curve fills; 'instant' seeds the pool at a starting valuation and trades there from birth. Set the curve with starting_fdv_eth + raise_target_eth (or leave the protocol defaults), or an instant launch with starting_fdv_eth (or seed_tick). Optional dev buy (dev_buy_eth or dev_buy_percent), pool fee model (fee_mode 'dynamic' by default with fixed_fee_pips as base fee, or 'fixed'; lp_share_bps for the LP share; extensions such as sniper-tax or maturity-curve from list_extensions), a staking vault with community_fee_ratio, an alternative fee recipient, and social links embedded in the description. Everything but the fee recipient is frozen at creation. Costs the creation fee (get_creation_fee, read live) plus the dev buy. Same creator + identical name/symbol/description/image is rejected.

image.description: Image reference: ipfs://<cid> (use upload_image first), a bare CID, or an https URL

community_fee_ratio.description: Percentage of the creator's fee income routed to the staking vault, 1-100 (default: 50). Only with deploy_staking; 0 without a vault.

salt.description: Salt for the deterministic coin address (32-byte hex or any memorable string, hashed). Default: random.

deploy_staking.description: Deploy a staking vault for the coin (default: true). When true, community_fee_ratio controls what share of the creator income goes to stakers.

alternative_fee_recipient.description: Optional address to receive the creator fees instead of the creator (e.g. a fee-recipient clone from create_fee_recipient).

twitter.description: X/Twitter link (e.g., x.com/username). Embedded in the coin description.

telegram.description: Telegram link (e.g., t.me/groupname). Embedded in the coin description.

website.description: Website URL (e.g., https://example.com). Embedded in the coin description.

launch_mode.description: 'curve' (default): bonding curve, graduates into the pool. 'instant': born in its Uniswap V4 pool, never graduates.

starting_fdv_eth.description: Starting fully-diluted valuation in ETH. Curve: launch FDV (= virtual reserves; window read from get_factory_params). Instant: seed valuation of the pool.

raise_target_eth.description: Curve only: ETH to raise before graduation (must be at least the minimum raise from get_factory_params).

virtual_reserves.description: Curve only, advanced: raw virtual reserves in wei (with initial_supply); replaces the FDV / raise knobs.

initial_supply.description: Curve only, advanced: raw coins held back for the pool, in wei (with virtual_reserves).

seed_tick.description: Instant only, advanced: the pool seed tick (multiple of 60) instead of starting_fdv_eth.

dev_buy_eth.description: ETH to spend on a creator buy in the same transaction (curve buy or pool swap). Capped by the dev-buy cap (max_creator_buy_bps).

dev_buy_percent.description: Alternative to dev_buy_eth: percent of the supply to buy at launch (0-25, capped by the live dev-buy cap); the ETH is quoted for you.

fixed_fee_pips.description: Base pool fee in pips (1e6 = 100%; 10000 = 1%). Default 10000. Max 100000 (10%).

lp_share_bps.description: Share of each pool swap fee that goes to LPs, in bps (default 7000 = 70%). The rest is split creator/community and protocol.

fee_mode.description: 'dynamic' (default): pool fee follows volatility between floor / mid / cap (dynamic-fee extension). 'fixed': flat fee = fixed_fee_pips.

dynamic_fee.description: Dynamic-fee steps in pips: {floor_fee, mid_fee, cap_fee} strictly ascending (defaults 3000 / 5000 / 12000). Only with fee_mode dynamic.

extensions.description: Extra hook extensions from list_extensions: [{"id": "sniper-tax", "params": {"peakFee": 500000, "window": 600}}, {"id": "maturity-curve", "params": {"steps": [{"age": 0, "fee": 20000}, ...]}}]. Ids or raw addresses.

hook_config.description: Advanced: raw hex hook payload (schema v2) instead of fee_mode / fixed_fee_pips / lp_share_bps / dynamic_fee / extensions.

tools.name: trigger_graduation
tools.description: Execute the final curve buy that fills the bonding curve and graduates the coin into its locked Uniswap V4 pool. Any excess ETH is refunded by the curve. The graduation payouts (fee recipient share, protocol share, caller share) are read live with check_graduation; when the caller share is zero this is a way to graduate a coin you care about, not an arbitrage. Use check_graduation first to see the ETH needed.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: pool_swap
tools.description: Swap on a coin's Uniswap V4 pool through the Universal Router (graduated or instant coins). Provide EXACTLY ONE of amount_in (exact-input: spend X) or amount_out (exact-output: receive exactly X). side='buy' spends native ETH and returns coins; side='sell' spends coins (Permit2 approval set up on demand) and returns native ETH. Slippage applies to the unspecified side (minimum out for exact-input, maximum in for exact-output). Always pre-quotes through the V4 quoter, which runs the hook, so the pool's dynamic fee is included. Unused ETH on an exact-output buy is swept back. Throws for a curve coin that has not graduated.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

side.description: 'buy' = ETH in / coin out; 'sell' = coin in / ETH out

amount_in.description: Exact-input: amount you spend, decimal string (ETH for buy, coins for sell). Mutually exclusive with amount_out.

amount_out.description: Exact-output: amount you receive, decimal string (coins for buy, ETH for sell). Mutually exclusive with amount_in.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in bps (default: from config)

recipient.description: Recipient of the output (default: agent wallet)

hook_data.description: Optional hex hookData for the pool hook (advanced; observer attribution). Default: none.

tools.name: approve_pool_sell
tools.description: Set up the approvals a pool sell needs ahead of time: coin -> Permit2 (ERC-20 approve) and Permit2 -> Universal Router. sell_token / pool_swap do this on demand; call it explicitly to pay the approval gas before a time-sensitive exit. Skips whatever is already sufficient.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: add_liquidity
tools.description: Add liquidity to a coin's Uniswap V4 pool through the PositionManager (graduated or instant coins). Native ETH is sent as msg.value (currency0) and the coin (currency1) is pulled through Permit2, approved on demand. Provide BOTH amount_eth_max and amount_token_max: the position takes what the tick range and current price need and refunds the unused ETH. Use position_token_id to increase an existing position; omit to mint a new one. Tick presets: 'full' (default, whole range), 'narrow' (about ±5%), 'wide' (about ±25%); explicit tick_lower / tick_upper override the preset. Your position earns the LP share of every swap fee (lp_share_bps of the pool).

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

amount_eth_max.description: Upper bound of ETH to add, decimal string. Sent as msg.value; the unused part is refunded.

amount_token_max.description: Upper bound of coins to add, decimal string. Pulled through Permit2.

position_token_id.description: Existing position id to increase. Omit to mint a new position.

tick_lower.description: Explicit lower tick (aligned to the tick spacing of 60).

tick_upper.description: Explicit upper tick (aligned to the tick spacing of 60).

tick_preset.description: Bracket the position around the current tick: 'full' = whole range, 'narrow' ≈ ±5%, 'wide' ≈ ±25%. Default 'full'. Ignored when explicit tick_lower/tick_upper are supplied.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage in bps applied to the minimum amounts (default: from config).

recipient.description: Position recipient for new mints (default: agent wallet).

tools.name: remove_liquidity
tools.description: Withdraw liquidity (and the fees it accrued) from one of your Uniswap V4 positions on a Frontier pool. Provide EXACTLY ONE of liquidity_pct (0–100, default 100) or liquidity (absolute units). When the position is fully drained it is burned by default (override with burn=false). ETH comes back as native ETH, the coin as ERC-20.

liquidity_pct.description: Percent of position liquidity to remove (0 < pct ≤ 100). Default: 100. Mutually exclusive with `liquidity`.

liquidity.description: Absolute liquidity units to remove (advanced). Mutually exclusive with `liquidity_pct`.

burn.description: Burn the position after it is fully drained. Default: liquidity_pct === 100.

tools.name: collect_fees
tools.description: Collect the swap fees accrued by one of your Uniswap V4 positions on a Frontier pool WITHOUT changing the position size (a zero-liquidity decrease that takes both currencies). ETH is paid as native ETH. For the protocol-locked liquidity of a coin use collect_pool_fees instead.

tools.name: get_lp_positions
tools.description: List the Uniswap V4 positions an address holds on Frontier pools (default: agent wallet), enumerated from the PositionManager. Filter to one coin with token_identifier. Each position reports its pool id, tick range, liquidity and the ETH / coin amounts it holds at the current price.

owner.description: Address whose positions to enumerate (default: agent wallet).

token_identifier.description: Optional coin (address, symbol or name) to filter positions to its pool.

tools.name: collect_pool_fees
tools.description: Collect the fees accrued by a coin's protocol-locked liquidity (the pool positions seeded at graduation or at an instant launch). Anyone can trigger it; the proceeds are split between the creator side (fee recipient and, when a vault exists, its community share) and the protocol treasury, as configured today. Nothing goes to the caller.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: set_fee_recipient
tools.description: Change the fee recipient of a coin: the address that receives the creator's share of curve fees, graduation payout and pool fees. Only the coin creator can set it the first time; afterwards only the current recipient can hand it on. Once a fee-recipient contract (lottery, buyback-and-burn, fee splitter) holds the role it never moves again.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: create_fee_recipient
tools.description: Deploy a fee-recipient contract for a coin from Frontier's clone factory: 'buyback-burn' (fees buy the coin back and burn it; optional creator share), 'fee-splitter' (fees split between payees by bps), or 'lottery' (fees fund periodic draws among traders; the clone is created empty, then bound as an observer at deploy_token and named fee recipient — its round settings live in that observer binding). For buyback-burn and fee-splitter, route the coin's fee stream to the clone with set_fee_recipient (irreversible once the clone holds the role). Only kinds registered on this chain can be created; the tool fails with a clear message otherwise.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

share_recipient.description: buyback-burn: address that receives an optional creator share of the fees

share_bps.description: buyback-burn: creator share in bps (max 5000), together with share_recipient

shares.description: fee-splitter: shares in bps, same length as payees, summing to 10000

salt.description: Optional: 32-byte hex salt for a deterministic clone address (any string is hashed).

tools.name: request_lottery_draw
tools.description: Close a lottery round and commit it to a future block's hash, the first of the two steps that settle a draw. Anyone can call it. A round can only be requested once its ticket window has elapsed; the commitment expires after 256 blocks, and an expired round has to be requested again. Read get_fee_recipient_state first to see which round is drawable.

tools.name: finalize_lottery_draw
tools.description: Settle a lottery round that was already requested: picks the winner from the committed block hash, weighted by tickets, and pays the prize. Anyone can call it, and only once the committed block has been mined. Rounds can settle out of order.

tools.name: claim_recipient_share
tools.description: Pay out the creator share a lottery has accrued to the share recipient configured for it. Anyone can call it: the destination is fixed by the contract, so the call only moves funds where they already belong. Nothing goes to the caller.

tools.name: trigger_buyback_burn
tools.description: Spend a buyback-and-burn contract's accumulated fees on the coin and burn what it buys. Anyone can call it; nothing goes to the caller. The swap runs against the coin's own pool, so pass min_coin_out as a floor — without one the trade takes any price. Read get_fee_recipient_state for the balance waiting to be spent.

min_coin_out.description: Minimum coin the buyback must receive, in coin units (default "0" — no floor)

tools.name: distribute_split_fees
tools.description: Pay a fee splitter's accumulated fees out to its payees, each by their configured share. Anyone can call it; nothing goes to the caller, and the split cannot be changed after the contract is created.

tools.name: set_recipient_share_recipient
tools.description: Change where a lottery or buyback-and-burn contract pays its creator share. Only the coin creator can call it, and only when a share was configured when the contract was created — the size of the share itself is fixed for good.

share_recipient.description: New destination for the creator share

kind.description: Optional: the contract kind (read from the clone factory when omitted)

tools.name: otc_transfer
tools.description: Direct ERC-20 transfer of a coin to another address, outside the curve and the pool. Works once the coin trades on its Uniswap V4 pool (graduated, or an instant launch); a curve coin cannot be transferred before graduation. Check with check_otc_transfer first.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

amount.description: Coin amount to transfer (decimal string, e.g. "1000")

tools.name: highlight_token
tools.description: Pay ETH to highlight (promote) a coin on Frontier for a duration. Pricing is linear up to a threshold, then each extra second costs more; one highlight is active at a time and a coin has a cooldown after its highlight ends. Quote with get_highlight_status first. Booking may not be open on the app yet.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

duration_seconds.description: How long the highlight runs, in seconds (get_highlight_config has the live bounds and price)

tools.name: claim_referral_reward
tools.description: Claim accumulated WETH referral rewards from the ReferralManager. Rewards accrue when traders you referred pay curve fees on their trades.

reward_token.description: Reward token address to claim (WETH on Frontier — see get_referral_reward)

tools.name: stake_tokens
tools.description: Deposit a coin into its staking vault to earn the community share of the creator's fee income: coin rewards accrue in the share price and WETH rewards are claimable with claim_staking_rewards. Receives vault shares (st<SYMBOL>) proportional to the deposit. Only coins whose creator deployed a vault; the coin must be transferable (on its pool).

vault_address.description: Staking vault address (get_staking_vault_address resolves it from the coin)

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

amount.description: Coin amount to stake (decimal string, e.g. "1000")

tools.name: request_unstake
tools.description: Request a withdrawal from a staking vault by coin amount. Starts the cooldown during which the coins cannot be claimed (a new request restarts the clock for everything in cooldown). Use get_cooldown_status to monitor progress.

tools.name: request_unstake_by_shares
tools.description: Request a withdrawal from a staking vault by redeeming a number of vault shares. Starts the cooldown. Use when you want to redeem a specific number of shares rather than a coin amount.

tools.name: complete_unstake
tools.description: Claim the coins from a staking vault after the cooldown completed (all of them at once). They are sent to the receiver (defaults to the agent wallet).

receiver.description: Optional: receive to a different address

tools.name: claim_staking_rewards
tools.description: Claim the WETH rewards a staking vault owes the agent wallet (the community share of pool fees and locked-liquidity collections). Coin rewards need no claim: they accrue in the share price. Check with get_staking_rewards first.

tools.name: release_vested_tokens
tools.description: Release vested coins that passed their cliff and vesting period. They are sent to the beneficiary of the vesting schedule (only the beneficiary can release). Use get_vesting_info to check releasable amounts.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: create_vesting_schedule
tools.description: Create a vesting schedule of a coin for one or more beneficiaries. Coins are locked in the vesting contract and released linearly over the duration (minimum 14 days) after an optional cliff. Works before graduation too (the vesting contract is exempt from the transfer lock). The agent must hold the coins and auto-approves the vesting contract when auto_approve is enabled.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

beneficiaries.description: Array of beneficiary addresses (parallel with amounts)

amounts.description: Array of coin amounts per beneficiary (e.g. ['1000', '2000'])

cliff_seconds.description: Cliff period in seconds (default: 0, no cliff)

slice_period_seconds.description: Release slice period in seconds (default: 1, continuous)

start_time.description: Vesting start as Unix timestamp in seconds (default: current time)

tools.name: start_strategy
tools.description: Start a trading strategy. Choose a preset mode (conservative/moderate/aggressive) or provide custom config overrides. Strategies run in the background monitoring Frontier events and executing trades automatically.

name.description: Strategy name (e.g. LaunchSniper, Momentum, GraduationSniper, ExitMonitor)

config.description: Custom config overrides (optional, merged with preset defaults)

copy_targets.description: CopyTrader only: wallet addresses whose trades this strategy mirrors

copy_scale_factor.description: CopyTrader only: size of a mirrored trade relative to the target (1 = same size, 0.5 = half)

tools.name: stop_strategy
tools.description: Stop a running trading strategy by name. The strategy will stop monitoring events and no longer execute trades.

tools.name: get_strategy_status
tools.description: Check status of running trading strategies. Shows which strategies are active, their positions, and P&L.

name.description: Specific strategy name (optional, omit to see all)

tools.name: list_available_strategies
tools.description: List all available trading strategies with their descriptions, configuration fields (with defaults and valid ranges), and preset modes (conservative/moderate/aggressive).

tools.name: generate_referral_link
tools.description: Generate a Frontier referral link (frontier.fun?ref=<wallet>). Anyone who trades on a bonding curve after opening this link is referred to you and you earn a share of the curve fees they pay, in WETH.

tools.name: describe_protocol
tools.description: Get a description of Frontier: the two launch modes (bonding curve graduating into a locked Uniswap V4 pool, or instant launch straight into the pool), the fee model on the curve and on the pool, extensions, staking vaults, referrals, locked liquidity, and every action this toolset offers, plus the live governance parameters read from the factory.

tools.name: preview_stake
tools.description: Preview how many vault shares you would receive for a given coin deposit without executing the stake. Use before committing to verify expected shares.

tools.name: preview_unstake
tools.description: Preview how many coins you would receive for redeeming a given amount of vault shares without executing. Use before committing to verify expected returns.

tools.name: calculate_cost
tools.description: Calculate the exact ETH cost to buy a specific quantity of a curve coin via the on-chain CurveMath contract. Returns a full fee breakdown: gross cost (before the curve fee), fee amount, net cost with the fee included, fee rate in basis points, and the coin amount in wei. Use when you need the exact ETH cost for a coin quantity. For coins received for a given ETH amount, use quote_buy instead. Curve coins only.

token_identifier.description: Coin address (0x...), symbol (e.g. "DOGE"), or name. Resolved automatically.

tools.name: update_config
tools.description: Update agent configuration at runtime. Accepts partial config -- only specified fields change. Controls trading defaults (slippage, gas reserve, max trade size, auto-approve), risk parameters (stop-loss %, take-profit %, max exposure, max open positions), and operational flags (logging level). Some fields are locked (dryRun, autoApprove) and cannot be changed via this tool.

trading.description: Trading defaults: slippage, affiliate, max trade size, gas reserve

risk.description: Risk limits: stop-loss, take-profit, exposure and open-position caps

ops.description: Operational flags: logging level and webhook (dryRun and autoApprove are operator-only)

tools.name: update_tx_gate
tools.description: Update transaction safety limits: maximum ETH per transaction, rolling 24-hour budget, cooldown between write operations, confirmation threshold, and coin blacklist. These limits protect the agent wallet from overspending.

confirm_above_eth.description: Ask confirmation above this ETH (0 = never)

enabled.description: Must stay true — the gate cannot be disabled through a tool call

tools.name: spending_stats
tools.description: View current spending summary: total ETH spent in the rolling 24-hour window, remaining daily budget, transaction count, TxGate configuration, and wallet address. Use to monitor the agent spending against safety limits.

tools.name: get_wallet_info
tools.description: Get the agent wallet address, current ETH balance on Robinhood Chain, and operating mode (read-only if no private key configured, or read-write with signing capability).

tools.name: get_failed_txs
tools.description: Get the list of failed transactions including dead-lettered (retry exhausted), confirmation timeouts (tx submitted but receipt not received), and aborted operations. Returns up to 50 most recent entries.

tools.name: send_eth
tools.description: Send native ETH to an arbitrary address on Robinhood Chain. Goes through TxGate for budget tracking and safety limits. Use for tipping, payments, or moving ETH between wallets.

tools.name: get_tx_history
tools.description: Get the rolling history of confirmed transactions. Returns up to 100 most recent successful write operations with tx hashes, amounts, timestamps, and types. Does NOT include failed transactions (use get_failed_txs for those).

limit.description: Max transactions to return (default: all, max 100)

type.description: Filter by tx type: buy, sell, deploy, graduate, stake, unstake, highlight, claim, vesting, transfer, other

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Get a portfolio summary for the agent's own wallet: ETH balance, the coins it holds and claimable referral rewards, in one call. Staking and vesting are per-coin reads and are not enumerated here — name a coin with get_staking_position or get_all_vesting_schedules. Requires a wallet.

tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.description: Get all wallet balances, names, tags, and busy status. Returns single wallet info if multi-wallet is not configured.

instructions: Frontier launchpad MCP server: launch and trade coins on Robinhood (4663). A coin either sells along a bonding curve and graduates into its own locked Uniswap V4 pool, or launches instantly straight into that pool. Provides 84 tools for coin trading (bonding curve and pool, auto-routed), launching, pool swaps and LP management, locked-liquidity collections, fee recipients and extensions, staking, vesting, referrals, highlights, and portfolio management. Use the evaluate-trade prompt for the standard trading workflow and launch-coin for a launch. Read frontier://protocol for the launch modes, the fee model and the tool map. Read frontier://wallet for the current wallet state. Read frontier://safety-rules BEFORE any write operation; it contains the operational constraints and slippage guidance. Read frontier://token-state-schema to interpret get_token_state output fields. Read frontier://config-schema for update_config/update_tx_gate defaults and valid ranges. Read frontier://wallet-setup to explain env var configuration and how to enable writes. Read frontier://chains for the chain registry (addresses, RPCs, curve defaults) and frontier://extensions for the hook extension catalog. Write tools (buy, sell, deploy, ...) require a configured wallet and spend ETH; check frontier://config for live limits. ALWAYS quote before trading: quote_buy / quote_sell on the bonding curve, quote_pool_swap (and preview_pool_fee) on the pool. Strategies (start_strategy) REQUIRE a wss:// RPC URL; the SDK rejects HTTP endpoints. Call list_available_strategies to discover per-strategy config fields and preset modes (conservative/moderate/aggressive). Defaults to read-only mode when no wallet key is configured; all read tools still work.
